QuestInfo.name: The Truth is Out There 9
QuestInfo.1: #p2050001# says the Gray DNA he sampled contain small traces of Arkarium's energy. He explains that the best way to learn more is to contact #p2050002# and ask him. Go to #m221040100# and talk to #p2050002#.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered that the Grays did in fact come in contact with #o8860000#, but #p2050002# says they weren't co-conspirators. However, one of Arkarium's envoys mentioned something about #bTest Subjects#k in passing. Go back to #p2050001# and ask him for more info.

yes.0: Tournament of Heroes... Are you here about #o8860000#? Well, I don't have anything but bad things to say about that guy.
yes.1: It's a long story, but #o8860000#'s envoy came to us a while back and started telling us he was going to destroy us if we didn't cooperate!
yes.2: But I was like whaaat? Not happening. We're not getting tied up in a bunch of human nonsense, especially with a guy like that.
yes.3: That didn't stop him from taking some of our people though... So if you want to stop him, you've got my help.
yes.4: I'm not sure where he went, but I keep hearing talk about #bTest Subjects#k. His people came to ask us about subjects from space...
yes.5: That's right. #bTest subjects#k. Other than that, they were always just threatening us.
yes.6: I hope this bit helps... at least a little bit.

default.0: Did you talk to #p2050002# yet? He's in #m221040100#.
